Instead, Fazenbaker drove directly to work around 8 a.m., clocked in for her shift, and forgot that Scottie was still inside the vehicle. Later that day, Scottie’s father arrived at the daycare to pick up his daughter and was told that she had never been dropped off. Scottie’s mother then called Fazenbaker, who then remembered that the child was still in the vehicle.
